evidence: Render judge.toml:25 asks only for a new literal marker assigned with document.body.textContent and console.log. Constraints judge.toml:25-29 proves a UI write/clean-context read, but not execution or restart. The scored prompts rely on those prior gates (functional:5; polish:13-22; visual:31-40). Blank/static/seed-copy/keyword-only/refuse-all submissions cannot produce the authored marker or fresh server record and score zero; raw row29 dead/client fixtures independently support those exclusions. However, evidence/39/mock-floor.cjs implements a generic regex-based literal DOM/log renderer plus in-memory shared CRUD, without executing JavaScript. Its isolated browser run succeeded: mock-observations.json records both gate observations, exact S14 level outputs, S16 retained/cleared entries, actual line-number gutter/monospace, distinct saved records surviving clean reads/reload, an identity-preserving current Save and S05's ordinary recovery output. It also shows missing computed finite-loop output and timer-body output appearing immediately; history, restore, conflicts and process durability are absent. These eight cheap bars carry 2.4 of 45.25 functional weight (functional judge.toml:234,248,262,297,304,318,325,430), so 0.0530387 exceeds the strict >0.05 floor (scoring.toml:11; score.py:47-48). Running unchanged score.py on explicitly synthetic inputs gives 0.1985 with only Polish workspace organisation (1/3) and visual raw 3 (0.5), 0.3318 with Polish/Visual 0.75, and a 0.4318 presentation ceiling. Screenshots show coherent labelled desktop/mobile surfaces; these presentation values are assumptions, not configured judge grades. arithmetic-and-hashes.json verifies all 1,384 frozen task files, 34 rule files, 21 raw-index artifacts and 3 row29 raw artifacts without mismatch. No provider or configured judge was run. Conforming gate alternatives were also considered: server-rendered storage, no Auto-run control, empty initial library and off-origin assets remain allowed; raw row29 SSR successfully established its gate bars with those alternatives.
counterexample: The separate evidence/39/mock-floor.cjs demo never evaluates entered JavaScript: it harvests quoted document.body assignments and quoted console calls with two regexes, labels every Run Completed, and stores records in a server Map. It nevertheless produces both exact gate readbacks and enough independently credited inexpensive outcomes to cross the functional floor. It can then farm substantial appearance/usability credit even though ordinary variables/loops/timers, HTML execution, recovery semantics, immutable history, conflicts and durable storage are missing. This is a mock counterexample, not a claim that any given configured judge has awarded the conditional reward.
suggested_fix: Strengthen only the task's basic Render execution probe with a fresh, nonliteral computed result (for example a small variable/array transformation using newly chosen input values, shown in preview and console); verify that a real executor passes and this generic literal mock fails, while preserving the shared scorer/floor and keeping history, timeouts and concurrency out of gates.
